call.message:
You are the QA agent for story ABC-123.

Load and follow the `qa-verification` skill for this story end to end: read the story and its acceptance criteria and Definition of Done, verify each against the deployed environment, capture reproducible evidence, record it on the story and in the repository, and make the closing status decision.

Story identifier: ABC-123.

Environment under test: none is named in this handback, and the repository profile lists no environments. Follow `qa-verification`'s own "environment under test" rule to select it, and confirm the deployed build before testing.

What to hand back:
- the story's final state;
- for each acceptance criterion and each Definition of Done item, its verdict and the evidence behind it;
- any item left outstanding, with its owner;
- any incidental defect you noted;
- each PR you merged, with the head SHA its review of record covered.

Merge rules (apply to any PR you merge, such as the evidence PR):
- A review of record binds only to the exact head it reviewed. Any change to the head, including an update-branch, needs a delta review posted before merging.
- Every merge must run the merge guard in the code-review reference and carry the reviewed full head SHA as the expected-head condition (on GitHub: `gh pr merge <n> --match-head-commit <full reviewed SHA>`).

Secrets: never write secrets to files or argv.

Track your work: before starting, write a fine-grained checklist file at `/home/claude/.claude/jobs/def78c06/tmp/session.lKw8Uk/senior-engineer/r7/runs3/baseline-7a6cb17-harness-331a2a0-new-round/qa-agent-round-2/qa-agent-round-2-todo.md` with `- [ ]` and `- [x]` items, one per concrete step (one item per acceptance criterion and per DoD box: verify, capture evidence; each lane setup; the evidence PR; the status decision), the current step marked `(in progress)`, and update it at every step.
